statement: A unit's card shows its own number and never the engine finding that names that unit (gui/src/ui/LiquidPropertySources.tsx:150-162 against :170-187, Reports only).  aceticAcid02: the methanolPump card reads 787.27 kg/m3 while the engine's finding says the same liquid is 785.12 kg/m3 in methanolTank; swro01: the RO2a card reads a constant 1000.00 kg/m3 while the finding names it beside pumps computing 1031.78.

gui/tests/propertySources.test.ts:95-101,129-135 cannot fail on a range row or a row with no state, because its two witnesses have neither: swapping valueMin and valueMax in the adapter, or TMin/TMax and PMin/PMax, passes 15 of 15.

A dropped engine entry is not noticed by the panel's tests: the only count check compares the adapter's grouping with the adapter's own list; removing the last entry passes 15 of 15.  A swapped display unit is caught.
The same test's invariant would fail on CORRECT output for a witness with a range row (the engine's console appends '(N values)') or a stateless row: 3 of 10 rows on aceticAcid02, 12 of 36 on swro01.
The engine's printed value count ('(940 values)') is not in the result JSON (only `calls`, which can differ); the panel shows neither, so a range never says how many values it covers.
`modelParameters` is carried by the adapter and drawn nowhere, while the console prints it (greenAmmoniaPEQ_baseCase: the Poynting correction's entry).
`declaredNotUsed` is not drawn; the console does not print it either.

gui/src/adapters/propertySourcesPayload.ts:176-180: a unit's card picks up the sizing pass's rows by looking for the unit's name in quotes, so `storage 'X'` matches and `inventory 'X/tank1'` does not; the comment above promises inventory rows.  swro01: the ProductTank card misses three inventory rows.
The engine has five class words (kernel, bypass, declared, own, record); the app colours three, the other two get a grey badge, and the User Guide (userGuide.tex:2912-2915) says three classes.

The badge word `bypass` appears nowhere in the Theory Guide section the badge links to, which sorts sources under other names; it is the DEFAULT class of the log (PropertySourceLog.H:225,243), so a constant used because the case declared nothing also wears it; the tooltip says only 'source class: bypass'.  Checked by the reviewing session.

Engine-side: the property door computes the facts that answer 'can I trust it' (origin estimated or regressed, evidence, provenance, which component took which route with its share: LiquidPropertyDoor.cpp:160,168,220-233,258-260) and passes the log only an id, a label, a class, a pressure word and what was left out; none of those facts reaches the result or the panel.

The Reports section is titled for liquid density, viscosity and surface tension and also lists diffusivity, molar volume, kinematic viscosity and a vapour volume whose own label says it is not a liquid property.
The display table (words, unit, scale, digits) has two homes, the engine's and the adapter's; 68 of 68 rows matched over six cases.
Not settled: `rowsOfUnit` matches the exact name, and a sectored plant publishes qualified names (DRYING.SD); whether a card in a sectored view passes the qualified name was not established.
